directReceiptHint: Goods received without a purchase order.

noOpenBills: No unpaid bills for this supplier.

nothingToAllocate: Every payment and credit note is fully applied.
nothingToBill: Nothing received from this supplier is waiting to be billed.
nothingToReturn: Nothing on this bill can be returned.
orderFullyReceived: Everything on this order has been received.
pickPurchaseOrderFirst: Pick the purchase order the goods came for.

searchSuppliers: Search name, short name or TIN…

settingsHubEinvoiceDesc: LHDN MyInvois connection, sandbox or production, signing certificate
einvStartDateHint: Documents dated before this are never submitted.
einvConnectionHint: Use the client ID and secret from the MyInvois portal (ERP system registration). Sandbox and production have separate credentials.
einvClientSecretKept: A secret is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
einvProductionWarning: Production submits real e-invoices to LHDN. Make sure the client ID and secret are the production ones, and enter the secret again.
einvIntermediaryHint: On behalf of another taxpayer who authorised this system.
einvApiBaseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the standard LHDN URL of the chosen environment.

einvUnsignedNotice: No certificate: documents are sent unsigned (version 1.0), which is fine for sandbox testing.
einvCertificateExpiring: This certificate expires within 30 days. Upload the renewed one before it lapses.
einvCertificateRemoveConfirm: Documents will be sent unsigned until a new certificate is uploaded.
einvSubmissionHint: Invoices and credit notes follow their own submission mode; self-billed documents use the mode below.

einvResubmitConfirm: Rebuild this document from the current data and submit it again?

einvSearchDocuments: Search number, buyer, TIN or UUID

einvVoidWillCancel: Its e-invoice will also be cancelled at LHDN (allowed until {{at}}).

einvModeDesc_S: Sent with the daily batch at {{time}} (Malaysia time).

einvSelfBilledCardHint: Self-billed: you issue the e-invoice on the supplier's behalf.

reasonForCreditPlaceholder: e.g. goods returned damaged, price adjustment…

bankGuideStep1: Pick the account and statement date
bankGuideStep1Text: Choose the bank account, then the closing date printed on your bank statement. Lines dated on or before it are listed below.
bankGuideStep2Text: Type the closing (ending) balance shown on the same statement, exactly as printed.
bankGuideStep3: Tick each line that appears on the statement
bankGuideStep3Text: Go down the statement and tick the matching line here (same amount, in or out). Leave lines not on the statement unticked. Each tick is saved straight away.
bankGuideStep3Working: Keep ticking until the Difference shows 0.00. If you have ticked everything and it is still not zero, see the tips below.
bankGuideStep4Text: Enabled once the Difference is 0.00. Only then are the account's last reconciled date and balance updated.
bankTipMissingTitle: On the statement but not listed here?
bankTipMissingText: Usually bank charges, interest or a payment not yet recorded. Record it first, then tick it:
bankTipExtraTitle: Listed here but not on the statement?
bankTipExtraText: E.g. a cheque not yet presented or a deposit in transit. Leave it unticked — it will be ticked on a later statement.
bankTipDifferenceText: Check for a line ticked by mistake, an amount entered differently from the bank, and that the statement date and balance are from the same statement.
bankStatementDateHint: The closing date on the bank statement.
bankStatementBalanceHint: The closing balance on that statement.
deliveryAddressHint: Opens only when the delivery address differs
deliverToOrderAddress: Deliver to the order's delivery address
deliverToWarehouseHint: The supplier delivers to the warehouse above. Untick to give another address.
signInSubtitle: Use your work email and password.
allowTransactionHint: Can be picked on invoices, bills, journals… Turn off for headings used only to group values in reports.
budgetAmountsHint: Amounts in the account's normal direction: an expense budget of 1,000 is 1000, a sales target of 5,000 is 5000.
budgetDeleteConfirm: Delete budget "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
budgetLinesHint: One row per account (and value), one amount per month.
budgetSplitByHint: Budget each value of a dimension separately (e.g. per cost centre). A group value budgets everything under it.
budgetSpreadPrompt: Yearly amount to spread evenly over the months:

defaultsSupplierHint: Filled in on purchase documents when the supplier is picked.
defaultsLead: Values filled in automatically on documents, so users rarely pick them by hand. They can still be changed on each document. Changes save straight away.
dimensionActiveHint: Inactive dimensions are hidden from documents; postings already tagged stay in reports.

dimensionPlEmpty: No income or expenses in this period.

dimensionValuesHint: Nest values under groups to roll them up in reports.
dimensionsLead: Tag documents with cost centres, departments or projects, budget by them, and see profit & loss per value.
noBudgetsHint: Set a monthly amount per account (optionally per cost centre) and compare it with actual postings.
noDimensionsExample: Start with e.g. "Cost Centre" with values like Head Office, Kuching, Miri.
pickBudgetToCompare: Pick a budget to compare with actual postings.
accessActive: Can sign in to this company
accessOpenReadHint: Everyone can read these for document dropdowns
accessOpenReadNote: Customers, suppliers, items, settings and dimensions (marked i) can always be read by everyone, because document forms need them in their dropdowns. The ticks control who can open their screens and change them.
accessPermissionsHint: Tick what people with this role can do. Doing anything in a module also needs View.
addUserHint: If the email already has an account (e.g. from another company), that person gets access here with their existing password.
adminRoleDescription: Full access to everything in the company.
adminRoleLocked: The Administrator role always has full access and can't be changed. Create your own roles for limited access.
leaveBlankToKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password
newAccountPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with the person; they can sign in straight away.
newPasswordHint: Setting a new password signs the person out everywhere.
noAccessNoRole: You have no role in this company. Ask your administrator for access.

removeAccessConfirm: Remove {{name}}'s access to this company? Their account and the records they made stay; you can give access back later.
rolesLead: A role is a set of permissions. Give each user a role to control which modules they can open and what they can create, change or void.
settingsHubRolesDesc: Roles and what each can see and do
settingsHubUsersDesc: People who can sign in, and their roles
userAccessRemoved: {{name}} can no longer sign in to this company
usersLead: Everyone who can sign in to this company. Add people, give them a role, or remove their access.

viewOnlyCannotCreate: Your role can't create records here.
globalSearchHint: Search by reference no, customer or supplier, their references, item code or description, remarks, memos or an amount.
posNoCounters: No active POS yet. Add one under Settings > Sales > POS Settings.
posTenderedShort: The amount received is {{amount}} short of the total.
posBuyerHint: Leave the customer blank for a walk-in sale.
posStockFrom: Stock items leave the POS's location.
posEinvoiceHint: Walk-in sales go into the monthly consolidated e-invoice.
posOverLimit: Above RM {{limit}}: this sale gets its own e-invoice (LHDN rule since 1 January 2026). Without a customer it is issued to "General Public".
posOwnEinvoiceHint: Pick the customer so the e-invoice carries their TIN. Otherwise the receipt goes into the monthly consolidated e-invoice.
posGeneralPublicTin: No customer: issued to "General Public" (TIN EI00000000010).
posConsolidatedNote: Goes into the consolidated e-invoice for {{period}}, due to LHDN by {{deadline}}.
posEnterQuantityToRefund: Enter the quantity to refund on at least one line.
posRefundConsolidatedNote: The receipt was consolidated, so this refund goes into the consolidated credit note for {{period}}, due by {{deadline}}.
posPickReceiptFirst: Refunds are made from a POS receipt. Open the receipt and click Refund.
posVoidReceiptText: {{ref}} will be voided: its postings are reversed and the goods go back into stock.
posVoidRefundText: {{ref}} will be voided: its postings are reversed and returned goods leave stock again.
posTaxGroupHint: Taxes charged on walk-in sales (a customer uses their branch's).
posPriceListHint: Default sales type for receipts at this POS.
consIntro: POS sales whose buyers did not ask for an e-invoice are reported to LHDN once a month.

consRuleOverLimit: A sale above RM10,000, or one where the buyer asks, gets its own e-invoice instead.
consRuleAuto: When the MyInvois scheduler is on, last month's consolidation is submitted automatically from the 3rd to the 7th. Fix anything LHDN rejects here.
consNothing: No POS sales to consolidate in {{year}}.
consNotAccepted: {{number}} was not accepted. See the error on the month.
consReleaseText: The documents of {{number}} go back to waiting; they can be consolidated again.
consPreviewHint: Each line of the e-invoice covers one POS for one day, listing its receipt numbers.

settingsHubEinvoiceSectionDesc: LHDN MyInvois connection, certificate and submission settings.
settingsHubUserManagementDesc: Who can sign in to this company and what each role may do.
